summary: Iteration 10 ALLIANCES frontend testing (390x844, demo account single-context). PRIMARY flows exercised end-to-end: dashboard, members (with role change DIPLOMAT<->VICE, invite errors, danger cancel), chat send, treasury, directory, public alliance page, PNA proposal, mercenary market with hire-submit validation, inbox with all event types, and regressions (Missioni segment, Mappa, /marches). Multi-account flows (war vote by ally, peace by third, mercenary contract acceptance by rival, lone-wolf create/dissolve/invite) were NOT executed in this pass — backend has been validated by pytest 8/8 per review request and every state observable from the demo perspective is correct; recommend a second run to exercise those inter-account handoffs if desired. NO deprecated Expo packages, NO React Native red-screen, NO console errors (only expected 404/409 during invite validation). ONE MINOR UI ISSUE: map legend text 'Tuo/Alleato/Nemico/Neutrale' not present in DOM even after toggling map-labels-button (see frontend_issues). Detailed results: (1) alliance-dashboard shows alliance-tag='[DEMO]', alliance-name='Lords Demo', alliance-kind='Strutturata', alliance-my-role='Leader', alliance-members-count='2 / 100', alliance-emeralds='5005', alliance-war-state='Neutrale', alliance-contracts-count='1 contratti attivi', 'Idonea alla Piramide' badge visible, all 6 nav buttons render. (2) MEMBERS: 2 rows — member-ply_b3869932233f 'Casa Demo (tuo) · Leader · dal 11/25/2026', member-ply_1ec94ada886e 'Casa Alleata · Vice · dal 11/25/2026' with per-member edit/transfer/kick buttons visible. Edit opens role chips (MEMBER/DIPLOMAT/VICE); clicking DIPLOMAT → badge became 'Diplomatico'; restoring VICE → badge back to 'Vice'. Invite panel: 'Casa Inesistente' → PLAYER_NOT_FOUND toast; 'Casa Rivale' → PLAYER_IN_ALLIANCE toast. Danger: alliance-leave visible, alliance-dissolve → confirm/cancel step; pressed alliance-dissolve-cancel only (no destructive action performed). (3) CHAT: alliance-chat-screen renders with 3 preloaded messages incl. SYSTEM herald 'Casa Alleata si è unito all’alleanza' (italic), 'Casa Demo Leader · Benvenuti nella Casa Demo!' gold bubble, 'Casa Alleata Vice · Grazie, Leader.'. Sent test message 'iter10-1789067300' → appeared instantly as gold Leader bubble at bottom; chat-input value cleared to ''. (4) TREASURY: alliance-treasury-amount='5005'; 7 ledger rows including 'first mission of day +5', 'mercenary escrow -1000', 'qa grant +3000', 'mercenary escrow refund +1500', 'mercenary escrow -2000', 'mercenary escrow -1500' — icons + reasons + amounts + player/contract ids present. (5) DIRECTORY: 3 rows — [MERC] Lame Assoldate Mercenaria '★ 10 · 1 contratti completati', [DEMO] Lords Demo (marked 'La tua alleanza'), [TRZ] Terza Via Strutturata. (6) TRZ PUBLIC PAGE: alliance-public-name='Terza Via', alliance-public-kind='Strutturata', alliance-public-relation='Neutrale', alliance-public-pna-propose/war-propose/hire buttons visible. (7) PNA propose from demo→TRZ: after tap, alliance-public-pna-proposal='Proposta PNA in sospeso' + alliance-public-pna-withdraw='Ritira' visible (relation still 'Neutrale' because unsigned proposal). (8) MERCENARY: alliance-mercenary-screen header 'vs bersaglio: +5% cap marcia · +3% ATK · Escrow 1000–1.0M · Durata 72/96/120/168h'. hire-escrow-input default '1000', 2 hire-target chips ([MERC]/[TRZ]), 4 hire-duration chips (72/96/120/168h). hire-submit correctly disabled when no target selected; ENABLED after selecting TRZ + escrow=1000 + 72h; DISABLED at escrow=500 (below min); DISABLED at escrow=9999999 (above 1M cap and treasury). Existing 7 contract-* rows (from prior iterations) rendered with status pills 'Attivo/Completato/Annullato', countdowns ('3g 3h'), suffix testIDs (contract-<id>-status/-ends). (9) INBOX: 50 inbox-item-* rows; DIPLOMACY STATE CHANGED events all show human-localized text ('Relazione tornata neutrale · [TRZ] Terza Via', 'Pace accettata — attesa 12h', 'Pace proposta', 'Guerra dichiarata', 'Voto di guerra aperto', 'PNA firmato', 'Preavviso fine PNA', 'Alleanza sciolta'); MERCENARY CONTRACT ACTIVE and EMERALD TREASURY MOVEMENT rows also render correctly with amounts and balance. Tapping a DIPLOMACY row navigates to /alliance/diplomacy (URL verified). (10) REGRESSION Missioni segment: 16 mission-card-* still render. (11) REGRESSION /marches renders 'Marce attive' screen with back-arrow (empty 'Nessuna marcia attiva' — no active marches for demo now). (12) REGRESSION Mappa renders WebGL scene with home yellow-flag ring, no console errors.
